item.vignette: Plasma from a patient with hemophilia is exposed to concizumab-mtci. Free tissue factor pathway inhibitor decreases, factor Xa generation during coagulation initiation rises, and thrombin generation improves without replacing factor VIII or IX.
item.lead_in: Which direct action best explains these findings?

options.A: Antagonism of tissue factor pathway inhibitor

item.tested_construct: TFPI antagonism enhancing factor Xa and thrombin generation
item.difficulty_basis: Requires mechanistic discrimination among plausible pharmacologic targets; author estimate only.

explanation.key_explanation: Concizumab-mtci is a monoclonal antibody antagonist of endogenous tissue factor pathway inhibitor (TFPI). TFPI inhibition enhances factor Xa production during coagulation initiation, improving thrombin generation and clot formation.

distractor_explanations.A: Correct. TFPI antagonism releases the brake on tissue-factor-initiated factor Xa generation.
distractor_explanations.B: The experiment explicitly shows benefit without factor VIII replacement.
distractor_explanations.C: Antithrombin activation would suppress coagulation rather than increase thrombin generation.
distractor_explanations.D: Direct factor Xa inhibition would oppose the observed increase in factor Xa activity.
distractor_explanations.E: Neutralizing tissue factor would reduce initiation of coagulation.

explanation.educational_objective: Recognize TFPI antagonism as a rebalancing strategy that increases factor Xa and thrombin generation without replacing deficient clotting factors.

item.vignette: NRG1-fusion-positive tumor cells are exposed to zenocutuzumab-zbco. NRG1 binding to HER3 and HER2:HER3 dimerization decrease, PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling falls, and antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity is observed.
item.lead_in: Which direct interaction best explains this profile?

options.A: Covalent inhibition of the intracellular HER2 kinase domain
options.B: Bispecific binding to extracellular HER2 and HER3
options.C: Neutralization of circulating NRG1 without receptor binding

item.tested_construct: Bispecific extracellular HER2/HER3 binding that blocks NRG1-driven heterodimer signaling
item.difficulty_basis: Requires mechanistic discrimination among plausible pharmacologic targets; author estimate only.

explanation.key_explanation: Zenocutuzumab-zbco is a bispecific antibody that binds extracellular HER2 and HER3, inhibits HER2:HER3 dimerization, prevents NRG1 binding to HER3, suppresses downstream PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling, and can mediate ADCC.

distractor_explanations.A: An intracellular kinase inhibitor would not explain simultaneous extracellular HER2/HER3 binding or ADCC.
distractor_explanations.B: Correct. Bispecific HER2/HER3 binding explains blockade of NRG1-driven dimerization and immune-effector activity.
distractor_explanations.C: The antibody directly binds HER2 and HER3 rather than only soluble NRG1.
distractor_explanations.D: PD-1 blockade does not directly prevent HER2:HER3 dimerization.
distractor_explanations.E: EGFR degradation is a different receptor mechanism.

explanation.educational_objective: Differentiate a bispecific HER2/HER3 antibody from kinase inhibition and ligand-only neutralization.

item.vignette: Autologous T cells are genetically modified to express an affinity-enhanced T-cell receptor. The engineered cells kill synovial-sarcoma cells only when a MAGE-A4 peptide is presented by HLA-A*02; CD19 expression is irrelevant.
item.lead_in: Which direct recognition event best explains tumor-cell killing?

options.A: A CAR binding native MAGE-A4 on the tumor-cell surface without HLA restriction
options.B: An anti-CD19 CAR engaging B-lineage cells
options.C: An engineered TCR recognizing an HLA-A*02-restricted MAGE-A4 peptide
options.D: A bispecific antibody linking CD3 to DLL3
options.E: A TCR recognizing any intracellular tumor antigen independent of HLA

item.tested_construct: Affinity-enhanced TCR recognition of HLA-A*02-restricted MAGE-A4 peptide
item.difficulty_basis: Requires mechanistic discrimination among plausible pharmacologic targets; author estimate only.

explanation.key_explanation: Afamitresgene autoleucel consists of autologous CD4- and CD8-positive T cells engineered to express an affinity-enhanced TCR specific for MAGE-A4. The TCR recognizes an HLA-A*02-restricted MAGE-A4 peptide, triggering T-cell activation and killing of MAGE-A4/HLA-A*02-expressing cells.

distractor_explanations.A: TCRs recognize peptide-HLA complexes rather than intact intracellular MAGE-A4 as a native surface antigen.
distractor_explanations.B: CD19 is not the antigen in this therapy.
distractor_explanations.C: Correct. The engineered TCR recognizes a MAGE-A4 peptide specifically in an HLA-A*02 complex.
distractor_explanations.D: DLL3×CD3 engagement describes a bispecific T-cell engager rather than an engineered antigen-specific TCR.
distractor_explanations.E: TCR antigen recognition is HLA restricted.

explanation.educational_objective: Distinguish HLA-restricted engineered TCR therapy from CAR-T and bispecific T-cell-engager mechanisms.

item.vignette: A recombinant bispecific protein is added to small-cell lung-cancer cells and autologous T cells. It simultaneously binds a tumor-associated surface antigen and CD3, causing T-cell activation, inflammatory cytokine release, and tumor-cell lysis.
item.lead_in: Which molecular bridge is formed by this drug?

options.A: HER2 on tumor cells to HER3 on the same tumor cell
options.B: PD-L1 on tumor cells to PD-1 on T cells
options.C: CD19 on tumor cells to an engineered CAR
options.D: DLL3 on tumor cells to CD3 on T cells
options.E: BCMA on plasma cells to FcRn

item.difficulty_basis: Requires mechanistic discrimination among plausible pharmacologic targets; author estimate only.

explanation.key_explanation: Tarlatamab-dlle is a bispecific T-cell engager that binds DLL3 on cells, including tumor cells, and CD3 on T cells. This bridge activates T cells, induces cytokine release, and lyses DLL3-expressing cells.

distractor_explanations.A: HER2/HER3 dual binding does not recruit T cells through CD3.
distractor_explanations.B: Checkpoint receptor binding is not the direct bridge formed by tarlatamab.
distractor_explanations.C: CAR recognition requires genetically modified T cells rather than a soluble DLL3×CD3 engager.
distractor_explanations.D: Correct. Tarlatamab bridges DLL3-expressing tumor cells to CD3-positive T cells.
distractor_explanations.E: BCMA/FcRn is unrelated to the labeled target pair.

explanation.educational_objective: Recognize a DLL3×CD3 bispecific T-cell engager from direct physical recruitment and activation of T cells against DLL3-positive tumor cells.

item.vignette: Cells expressing F508del-CFTR are treated with a three-drug combination. More mature CFTR reaches the plasma membrane, and the channels that reach the surface show a higher open probability.
item.lead_in: Which combined direct actions best explain these findings?

options.A: Three independent blockers of epithelial sodium channels
options.B: Two CFTR potentiators plus a chloride-channel pore blocker
options.C: One CFTR corrector plus two inhibitors of CFTR degradation
options.D: Activation of CFTR transcription plus inhibition of ENaC
options.E: Two CFTR correctors that improve processing/trafficking plus a CFTR potentiator that increases channel gating

item.tested_construct: Dual CFTR correction plus potentiation of channel gating
item.difficulty_basis: Requires mechanistic discrimination among plausible pharmacologic targets; author estimate only.

explanation.key_explanation: Vanzacaftor and tezacaftor bind different CFTR sites and facilitate processing and trafficking of selected mutant CFTR proteins to the cell surface. Deutivacaftor potentiates CFTR channel open probability at the cell surface.

distractor_explanations.A: ENaC blockade does not explain increased mature CFTR at the membrane or increased CFTR gating.
distractor_explanations.B: The combination uses two correctors and one potentiator, not two potentiators and a pore blocker.
distractor_explanations.C: The third component increases gating rather than merely blocking degradation.
distractor_explanations.D: The label describes direct protein correction and potentiation, not transcriptional activation.
distractor_explanations.E: Correct. Two correctors increase surface CFTR quantity and a potentiator increases function by raising open probability.

explanation.educational_objective: Distinguish CFTR correctors that improve protein processing/trafficking from a potentiator that increases channel gating.
